title: 64-bit read/write memory

sources.document: National Semiconductor TTL Data Book 1976, DM54/DM7489, L89A 64-Bit Read/Write Memories
sources.familyUsed: DM7489 (National; TI's 1976 TTL book does not carry the 7489)

pins.name: ME
pins.text: MEMORY ENABLE: low selects the chip; high = hold, outputs at logical 1 (off)

pins.name: WE
pins.text: WRITE ENABLE: low together with ME low writes D1-D4 into the addressed word; high reads

functions.formula: S1 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit1)
functions.text: Sense output 1: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 1 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off).

functions.formula: S2 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit2)
functions.text: Sense output 2: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 2 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off).

functions.formula: S3 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit3)
functions.text: Sense output 3: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 3 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off).

functions.formula: S4 = NOT (ME' AND WE AND M[D,C,B,A].bit4)
functions.text: Sense output 4: while reading (ME low, WE high) it is the complement of bit 4 of the addressed word; while writing (ME low, WE low) and while ME is high it is at logical 1 (open-collector off).

state.changesOn: while ME and WE are both low (write)
rules: 16 words of 4 bits, selected by the four select inputs A, B, C, D (fully decoded)
ME low, WE low: write D1-D4 into the addressed word; outputs at logical 1
ME low, WE high: read; outputs show the complement of the addressed word
ME high: hold (no write); outputs at logical 1

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 30 pF, RL1 300 ohm, RL2 600 ohm

VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 30 pF, RL1 300 ohm, RL2 600 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 30 pF, RL1 300 ohm, RL2 600 ohm; tSR: sense recovery time after writing (edge not stated)

electrical.notes: Open-collector outputs (wire-OR). IOL 12 mA, VOL max 0.4 V (DM74). Off-state output current IOH max 20 uA at VOH 5.5 V (DM74). Highest output voltage given: VOH 5.5 V. National lists these under electrical characteristics; the sheet has no separate recommended-operating-conditions table.

unknown: Which select input is the least significant address bit: the connection diagram names them A, B, C, D and the logic diagram A0-A3, but the sheet does not tie the two sets of names together.
Reference edge of the setup and hold times with respect to Write Enable: not stated.
Power-up content of the memory: not stated.
IOH as a source current does not apply (open collector); outputHighMaxCurrentMa is null.
notes: ND symbol title says 64-bit read/write memory; this file uses the National DM7489 sheet, which describes the same 16 x 4 part with open-collector inverted outputs. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
